source.numberingNote: eBible VPL code 4ES maps to traditional KJV 2 Esdras (not an additional book); SIR = Ecclesiasticus, WIS = Wisdom of Solomon.

EXO 20:10.verse: But the seventh day [is] the sabbath of the LORD thy God: [in it] thou shalt not do any work, thou, nor thy son, nor thy daughter, thy manservant, nor thy maidservant, nor thy cattle, nor thy stranger that [is] within thy gates:

MAR 2:27.verse: And he said unto them, The sabbath was made for man, and not man for the sabbath:

LUK 24:1.verse: Now upon the first [day] of the week, very early in the morning, they came unto the sepulchre, bringing the spices which they had prepared, and certain [others] with them.

ACT 20:7.verse: And upon the first [day] of the week, when the disciples came together to break bread, Paul preached unto them, ready to depart on the morrow; and continued his speech until midnight.

1CO 16:2.verse: Upon the first [day] of the week let every one of you lay by him in store, as [God] hath prospered him, that there be no gatherings when I come.

REV 1:10.verse: I was in the Spirit on the Lord’s day, and heard behind me a great voice, as of a trumpet,

ROM 14:5.verse: One man esteemeth one day above another: another esteemeth every day [alike]. Let every man be fully persuaded in his own mind.

COL 2:16.verse: Let no man therefore judge you in meat, or in drink, or in respect of an holyday, or of the new moon, or of the sabbath [days]:

HEB 4:9.verse: There remaineth therefore a rest to the people of God.
